Security Level: PUBLIC
UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION
Re: Large Load Interconnection, Co-Located Resources, and Grid Enhancing
Technologies
Docket Nos. EL26-67-000, EL26-68-000, EL26-69-000, EL26-70-000, EL26-71-000,
EL26-72-000, EL25-49-002, and AD10-12-017
SUBMISSION OF TECHNICAL EVIDENCE: GEOMETRIC PHASE ISOLATION (GPI) FOR
PASSIVE HARDWARE LEVEL VAR OFFLOADING



To: Debbie-Anne Reese,
Secretary Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
888 First Street, N.E.
Washington, D.C. 20426

Dear Secretary Reese,



Relentless Energy Systems LLC respectfully submits the enclosed technical evidence

and Xyce netlists and results to assist regional transmission organizations and the

Commission in mitigating the infrastructure impacts of large loads in support of the

Commission’s ongoing Show Cause orders. This filing provides comprehensive

analytical data, solver-verified models, and engineering specifications for a novel

Grid Enhancing Technology (GET) directly applicable to the large load interconnection

constraints and transmission congestion issues driven by the unprecedented national

growth of high-density loads.




This submission details Geometric Phase Isolation (GPI), a passive five‑dimensional

LCFVR parallel resonant manifold engineered to physically offload magnetizing VARs

at the Point of Load. The attached evidence demonstrates that GPI provides Xyce
                                            1
 solver verified hardware‑level VAR offloading through an internally circulating

reactive payload that maintains strict First Law thermodynamic parity. By preventing

upstream VAR propagation and its associated thermal transit constraints, the GPI

manifold materially increases available interconnection capacity without requiring new

transmission rights‑of‑way.


The following three (3) groups of documents are included in this public eFiling for

technical review by Commission engineering staff:

• GPI_Master_Netlist Capacitance Variance Sweep (5 Netlists)

             - GPI_Master-20%_Netlist.txt

             - GPI_Master-10%_Netlist.txt

             - GPI_Master_Netlist.txt

             - GPI_Master+10%_Netlist.txt

             - GPI_Master+20%_Netlist.txt

             - GPI_Composite_Dashboard.pdf

 •     RR-GPI_5D-LCFVR_Resilient-Resonance Sweep (1 Netlist)

             - RR-GPI_5D-LCFVR_Resilient-Resonance_Netlist.txt

             - RR-5D-LCFVR-GPI-ResilientResonance-Graph-Table.pdf

 •     Non‑Provisional Patent Application No. 19/546,421

         -   SPECIFICATION.pdf

         -   DRAWINGS.pdf




                                            2
 This filing is submitted unencrypted and without restriction into the public docket to

support rigorous technical evaluation of GPI as a viable, scalable Grid Enhancing

Technology. The submission complies with 18 CFR §§ 385.2001–2005 and is filed

electronically through FERC’s eFiling system.




Respectfully submitted,
/s/ Benjamin Donovan Blackketter
Benjamin Donovan Blackketter Founder,
ben@relentlessenergy.systems
Relentless Energy Systems LLC
relentlessenergy.systems
740.252.6922
Relentless Energy Systems LLC – Northwest Registered Agent
6545 Market Ave. North, STE 100
Canton, Stark County, OH 44721
United States

* ==============================================================================
* === GPI MASTER NETLIST - Thévenin’s Theorem ===
* Point-of-Load VAR Virtualization for AI Datacenters and EV Powertrains
* NPPA 19/546,421 :: PHASE-ISOLATED LCFVR ENERGY MANIFOLD (GPI)
* Benjamin Donovan Blackketter, Relentless Energy Systems LLC
* Copyright 2026 Benjamin Donovan Blackketter
* Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution No Derivatives 4.0 International
* SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-ND-4.0
* License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: SPICE Solver Directives (Auditor-Grade Precision).
* What it does: Enforces ultra-high-precision time integration (GEAR) with 1e-6 tolerances.
* Why it is there: Completely suppresses abstract floating-point drift and ensures absolute thermodynamic conservation in highly resonant AC LC circuits.
.OPTIONS TIMEINT RELTOL=1e-6 ABSTOL=1e-11 METHOD=GEAR MAXORD=2

* What it is: Linear Solver selection.
* What it does: Selects the KLU sparse matrix solver.
* Why it is there: KLU is specifically optimized for highly connected AC power circuits, drastically speeding up convergence.
.OPTIONS LINSOL TYPE=KLU

* What it is: Utility grid frequency parameter.
* What it does: Sets the fundamental driving AC frequency.
* Why it calculates the way it does: 60 Hertz is the standard AC frequency for North North American power grids.
.param F_BASE=60

* What it is: Peak voltage parameter.
* What it does: Sets the peak amplitude of the AC sine wave.
* Why it is there: Models the 175.0 Vpk required to supply the local manifold.
.param VPK=175.0

* What it is: Pi parameter.
* What it does: Defines the mathematical constant Pi to 10 decimal places.
* Why it calculates the way it does: Required for highly accurate derivation of inductive and capacitive reactance.
.param PI=3.1415926535

* ==============================================================================
* === GPI MANIFOLD MACHINE PARAMETERS (VAR VIRTUALIZATION ZONE) ===
* ==============================================================================
* The GPI_Master_Netlist.txt
* Phase Angle = 81.1 Degrees
* Source supplies ~100 Watts (Active Fuel). GPI virtualizes ~646 VARs (Reactive Shielding).
* GPI Manifold Output yields a resilient 0.87 HP composite electro-kinetic flywheel.

* What it is: Primary Inductance Parameter.
* What it does: Sets the heavy magnetic stator iron core to 61.5 millihenries.
* Why it is there: Provides the massive magnetic skeleton necessary to grip the load.
.param L_VAL=61.5m

* What it is: Primary Resistance Parameter.
* What it does: Sets the active footprint of the motor to 3.6 Ohms.
* Why it is there: Represents the physical kinetic work and intrinsic heat extracted by the machine.
.param R_VAL=3.6

* What it is: Active Capacitance Parameter.
* What it does: Sets the localized phase-firewall GPI manifold to 112.0 microfarads.
* Why it is there: Geometrically traps the heavy lagging VAR demand internally, suppressing EV DC-Link ripple and Behind-The-Meter conduit heating.
* .param C_VAL=112.0u (Master)
.param C_VAL=112.0u

* What it is: Equivalent Series Resistance (ESR) Parameter.
* What it does: Adds 0.015 Ohms of serial thermal resistance to the capacitor.
* Why it is there: Models the physical thermodynamic friction heat generated by the dielectric film.
.param C_ESR=0.015

* ==============================================================================
* === AC SOURCE (GRID & BEHIND-THE-METER INFRASTRUCTURE) ===
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: The ideal AC voltage source.
* What it does: Acts as the utility power plant generator, facility UPS, or EV battery DC-AC inverter.
* Why it calculates the way it does: Provides the mathematically pure sine wave reference at 0 degrees phase.
V_GEN n_src_ideal 0 SIN(0 {VPK} {F_BASE})

* What it is: Upstream Transmission & Site-Conduit Resistance.
* What it does: Provides 0.02 Ohms of serial resistance.
* Why it is there: Physically models the I^2R heat-loss resistance of the upstream utility grid lines, EV busbars, AND internal facility site-conduit.
R_SRC n_src_ideal n_src_mid 0.02

* What it is: Upstream Transmission Line Inductance.
* What it does: Provides 50 microhenries of serial inductance.
* Why it is there: Physically models the parasitic inductive latency of utility transformers, facility UPS systems, and internal sub-panels.
L_SRC n_src_mid n_src 50u

* What it is: Upstream boundary ammeter.
* What it does: A 0-Volt independent DC source acting as a perfect, lossless current probe.
* Why it is there: Used to measure the exact instantaneous current mathematically crossing the isolation boundary into the machine.
V_GRID_MONITOR n_src n1 0

* ==============================================================================
* === BRANCH A: RESERVOIR CAPACITOR (THE PHASE FIREWALL) ===
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: Capacitor branch ammeter.
* What it does: A 0-Volt ammeter placed strictly on the capacitor branch.
* Why it is there: Isolates and measures the pure leading reactive VAR current trapped natively internal to the GPI system.
V_CAP_MONITOR n1 nCap_in 0

* What it is: The ideal electrostatic storage medium (the capacitor plates).
* What it does: Provides the capacitance value {C_VAL}.
* Why it is there: The physical mechanism that virtualizes the heavy reactive flux demand at the Point-of-Load.
CRES nCap_in nC_mid {C_VAL}

* What it is: Equivalent Series Inductance (ESL).
* What it does: Adds 20 nanohenries of serial inductance to the capacitor.
* Why it is there: Models the physical high-frequency magnetic choke of the rolled foil and busbars.
L_ESL nC_mid nC_esl 20n

* What it is: ESL Damping Resistor.
* What it does: A high-value parallel mathematical resistor (1k Ohms) placed across the ESL.
* Why it is there: Prevents the SPICE solver from generating non-physical "ringing" errors.
R_ESL_DAMP nC_mid nC_esl 1K

* What it is: Equivalent Series Resistance (ESR).
* What it does: Injects the active thermal friction value {C_ESR}.
* Why it is there: Ensures the First Law of Thermodynamics is perfectly preserved by accounting for dielectric heat.
R_C nC_esl n_local_gnd {C_ESR}

* What it is: Parasitic ground-strap inductance.
* What it does: Adds 50 nanohenries of inductance to the ground return.
* Why it is there: Models the physical Earth leakage path.
L_EARTH n_local_gnd 0 50n

* ==============================================================================
* === BRANCH B: TRANSDUCER WORKLOAD ===
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: Motor branch ammeter.
* What it does: A 0-Volt ammeter placed exactly at the entrance of the motor branch.
* Why it is there: Measures the unified total heavy current (Active + Reactive) physically pushing through the machine.
V_MOTOR_I n1 nMotor_in 0

* What it is: Parasitic Inter-Winding Capacitance.
* What it does: Adds 100 picofarads of parallel capacitance to ground.
* Why it is there: Physically models the high-frequency dielectric leakage between tightly packed copper stator windings.
C_WINDING nMotor_in 0 100p

* What it is: Parasitic Insulation Leakage Resistance.
* What it does: Adds 10 Megohms of parallel resistance to ground.
* Why it is there: Physically models imperfect wire enamel insulation bleeding active current to the chassis.
R_LEAK_INS nMotor_in 0 10MEG

* What it is: The Workload Inductance.
* What it does: Provides the heavy stator coil inductance {L_VAL}.
* Why it is there: Represents the physical iron core responsible for translating heavy current into magnetic flux.
L_MOTOR nMotor_in nMotor_mid {L_VAL}

* What it is: The Active Kinetic Footprint.
* What it does: Provides the serial active resistance {R_VAL}.
* Why it is there: Physically models the heat and rotational kinetic work extracted from the axle.
R_MOTOR nMotor_mid 0 {R_VAL}

* ==============================================================================
* === THERMODYNAMIC POWER AUDIT ===
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: Source Power Behavioral Source.
* What it does: Multiplies Upstream Voltage by Upstream Current in real-time.
* Why it is there: Creates an instantaneous continuous power trace that can be averaged to find True Billed Watts.
BPSRC ps 0 V={V(n_src)*I(V_GRID_MONITOR)}

* What it is: Ghost resistor for the source power node.
* What it does: Connects the 'ps' node to ground with 1 Giga-Ohm.
* Why it is there: Satisfies SPICE matrix structure requirement.
R_PS_GND ps 0 1G

* What it is: Local Motor Power Behavioral Source.
* What it does: Multiplies the localized GPI Voltage by the localized Motor Current in real-time.
* Why it is there: Creates an instantaneous continuous power trace for the isolated motor branch.
BPMOTOR pi 0 V={V(n1)*I(V_MOTOR_I)}

* What it is: Ghost resistor for the local power node.
* What it does: Connects the 'pi' node to ground with 1 Giga-Ohm.
* Why it is there: Satisfies SPICE matrix structure requirement.
R_PI_GND pi 0 1G

* ==============================================================================
* === SIMULATION DIRECTIVES ===
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: Transient output print directive.
* What it does: Outputs raw sine-wave data to a CSV file.
* Why it is there: Allows visual graphing of the internal geometric leverage vectors.
.PRINT TRAN FORMAT=CSV I(V_MOTOR_I) I(V_GRID_MONITOR) I(V_CAP_MONITOR) V(n1)

* What it is: Transient simulation directive.
* What it does: Instructs the simulator to run a transient time-domain analysis for 3.0 seconds, measuring the final 100ms.
* Why it is there: Validates absolute steady-state equilibrium after all start-up transients have resolved.
.TRAN 100u 3.0 2.9 100u

* ==============================================================================
* === EXACT STEADY-STATE AC METROLOGY ===
* ==============================================================================

* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* [ DOMAIN 1: FULL-PATH UPSTREAM (MACRO-GRID & SITE-CONDUIT) ]
* [DOMAIN TAG: FTM & BTM THERMAL SHIELDING]
* Why it is here: Calculates mathematics strictly from the perspective of the upstream utility grid and internal facility site-conduit, proving massive infrastructure relief.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* What it is: Formatting spacer.
.MEASURE TRAN ____1_UPSTREAM_GRID_AND_SITE_CONDUIT_SHIELDED____ PARAM={0}

* What it is: Upstream RMS Voltage Measurement.
* What it means: Establishes the true physical voltage arriving through the site conduit.
.MEASURE TRAN UPSTREAM_RMS_VOLTAGE_V RMS V(n_src) FROM=2.9 TO=3.0

* What it is: Upstream RMS Current Measurement.
* What it means: The dramatically reduced electrical footprint. Unlocks stranded BTM ampacity (internal PDUs/wiring) and FTM capacity (utility substations).
.MEASURE TRAN UPSTREAM_RMS_CURRENT_A RMS I(V_GRID_MONITOR) FROM=2.9 TO=3.0

* What it is: Upstream Active Power Measurement (Watts).
* What it means: Proves the physical fuel burned by the powerplant (the Active "Top-Off").
.MEASURE TRAN UPSTREAM_REAL_POWER_P_W AVG V(ps) FROM=2.9 TO=3.0

* What it is: Upstream Apparent Power Calculation (VA).
* What it means: Dictates the physical maximum thermal sizing of grid transformers, UPS inverters, and internal facility PDUs.
.MEASURE TRAN UPSTREAM_APPARENT_POWER_S_VA PARAM={UPSTREAM_RMS_VOLTAGE_V * UPSTREAM_RMS_CURRENT_A}

* What it is: Upstream Power Factor Calculation.
* What it means: Proves the Point-of-Load phase firewall perfectly aligns the full upstream path to unity, blocking all VAR transit and eliminating grid/conduit line heating.
.MEASURE TRAN UPSTREAM_POWER_FACTOR PARAM={ABS(UPSTREAM_REAL_POWER_P_W) / (UPSTREAM_APPARENT_POWER_S_VA + 1e-12)}

* What it is: Theoretical Uncompensated Motor Reactive Demand (VARs).
* What it does: Calculates the physical inductive VARs required by the heavy stator core using exact geometric impedance: V^2 * X_L / Z^2.
* What it means: Establishes the exact "Before GPI" reactive penalty that the utility grid WOULD have suffered without the manifold.
.MEASURE TRAN TOTALBASE_MOTOR_VARS PARAM={((UPSTREAM_RMS_VOLTAGE_V * UPSTREAM_RMS_VOLTAGE_V) / ((R_VAL * R_VAL) + ((2 * PI * F_BASE * L_VAL) * (2 * PI * F_BASE * L_VAL)))) * (2 * PI * F_BASE * L_VAL)}

* What it is: Upstream Reactive Power Burden Calculation (VARs).
* What it does: Extracts the exact upstream reactive slosh using strict right-triangle logic (Sqrt(S^2 - P^2)).
* What it means: Definitively proves the Phase Firewall shields the utility and site-conduit. Evaluates to ~1.6 VARs (a 99.7% offload), confirming extremely low upstream I^2R losses.
.MEASURE TRAN UPSTREAM_REACTIVE_BURDEN_VAR PARAM={SQRT(ABS((UPSTREAM_APPARENT_POWER_S_VA * UPSTREAM_APPARENT_POWER_S_VA) - (UPSTREAM_REAL_POWER_P_W * UPSTREAM_REAL_POWER_P_W)))}

* What it is: Total Reactive Burden Offloaded from Grid & Facility Conduit (Net Virtualization Yield).
* What it does: Subtracts the grid's actual measured reactive burden from the motor's uncompensated baseline demand.
* What it means: The ultimate proof of the Resonance V-Curve. Quantifies the exact net reactive payload explicitly erased from the upstream conduit. It correctly penalizes both over-compensation and under-compensation, remaining mathematically flawless across extreme lifecycle degradation.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_SITE_CONDUIT_AND_GRID_OFFLOADED_VARS PARAM={TOTALBASE_MOTOR_VARS - UPSTREAM_REACTIVE_BURDEN_VAR}

* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* [ DOMAIN 2: THE LOCAL MANIFOLD (VAR VIRTUALIZATION ZONE) ]
* [DOMAIN TAG: TRAPPED INTERNAL TO GPI-ENABLED SYSTEM]
* Why it is here: Proves the massive reactive magnetic slosh is fully trapped and supported strictly internal to the GPI-enabled system.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* What it is: Formatting spacer.
.MEASURE TRAN ____2_LOCAL_VAR_VIRTUALIZATION_TRAPPED_INTERNALLY____ PARAM={0}

* What it is: Local RMS Voltage Measurement.
* What it means: Verifies that the internal manifold voltage remains rigidly supported.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_LOCAL_RMS_VOLTAGE_V RMS V(n1) FROM=2.9 TO=3.0

* What it is: Local Active Power Measurement (Watts).
* What it means: Calculates the total kinetic extraction. Proves exact Thermodynamic Parity with the Source.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_LOCAL_REAL_POWER_P_W AVG V(pi) FROM=2.9 TO=3.0

* What it is: Capacitor RMS Current Measurement.
* What it means: Audits the localized VAR virtualization. By trapping this slosh internal to the GPI system, it suppresses EV DC-Link ripple and facility PDU congestion.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_CAP_RMS_CURRENT_A RMS I(V_CAP_MONITOR) FROM=2.9 TO=3.0

* What it is: Capacitor Thermal Friction Loss (Dielectric Heat).
* What it does: Calculates the physical I^2R thermodynamic heat dissipated by the capacitor's internal Equivalent Series Resistance.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_CAPACITOR_THERMAL_LOSS_W PARAM={(GPI_CAP_RMS_CURRENT_A * GPI_CAP_RMS_CURRENT_A) * C_ESR}

* What it is: Motor RMS Current Measurement.
* What it means: Proves the massive heavy current (the Lorentz driver) is physically intact inside the machine.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MOTOR_RMS_CURRENT_A RMS I(V_MOTOR_I) FROM=2.9 TO=3.0

* What it is: Local Apparent Power Calculation (VA).
* What it means: Calculates the immense true vector sum required to generate the magnetic B-Field.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_LOCAL_APPARENT_POWER_S_VA PARAM={GPI_LOCAL_RMS_VOLTAGE_V * GPI_MOTOR_RMS_CURRENT_A}

* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* [ DOMAIN 3: THE SYSTEM MULTIPLIER (CROSS-DOMAIN LEVERAGE) ]
* [DOMAIN TAG: ELECTRO-KINETIC LEVERAGE RATIO]
* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* What it is: Formatting spacer.
.MEASURE TRAN ____3_ELECTRO_KINETIC_LEVERAGE_MULTIPLIER____ PARAM={0}

* What it is: Effective Current Magnification Calculation.
* What it means: Proves exactly how many physical force-generating amps exist internally per active amp drawn through the site-conduit.
.MEASURE TRAN EFFECTIVE_CURRENT_MAGNIFICATION PARAM={GPI_MOTOR_RMS_CURRENT_A / (UPSTREAM_RMS_CURRENT_A + 1e-12)}

* ==============================================================================
* === 4. THE VAR VIRTUALIZATION & RESILIENCE BASE ===
* [DOMAIN TAG: ELECTRO-KINETIC RESILIENCE & TVRT]
* Why it is here: Uses Pythagorean logic to prove the massive, unyielding mechanical HP envelope and strictly label the VARs.
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: Formatting spacer.
.MEASURE TRAN ____4_VAR_VIRTUALIZATION_AND_ELECTRO_KINETIC_RESILIENCE____ PARAM={0}

* What it is: Upstream Active Sub-vector (The Horizontal Base).
* What it means: Quantifies the purely active kinetic extraction and thermal waste.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_UPSTREAM_ACTIVE_W PARAM={ABS(UPSTREAM_REAL_POWER_P_W)}

* What it is: Localized VAR Virtualization (The Vertical Height).
* What it does: Multiplies Capacitor RMS Current by Local RMS Voltage.
* What it means: The undeniable proof of VAR Virtualization. Quantifies the immense Reactive Power trapped internally, isolating the Site-Conduit from transit heat.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_VIRTUALIZED_VAR PARAM={GPI_CAP_RMS_CURRENT_A * GPI_LOCAL_RMS_VOLTAGE_V}

* What it is: True Vector Sum of the Applied Force Envelope.
* What it means: Provides an auditor-proof dimensional metric (VA) of the true composite resilient force hitting the rotor.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_ELECTRO_KINETIC_VA PARAM={GPI_LOCAL_APPARENT_POWER_S_VA}

* What it is: Effective NEMA / IEC Motor Frame Equivalent.
* What it means: Mathematically proves the manifold natively provides Transient Voltage Ride-Through (TVRT). The internal magnetic stiffness equals a massive 0.87 HP machine, averting load starvation during brownouts.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_RESILIENT_HP_FRAME PARAM={GPI_MANIFOLD_ELECTRO_KINETIC_VA / 746}

.end

* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* What it is: Formatting spacer.
.MEASURE TRAN ____3_ELECTRO_KINETIC_LEVERAGE_MULTIPLIER____ PARAM={0}

* What it is: Effective Current Magnification Calculation.
* What it means: Proves exactly how many physical force-generating amps exist internally per active amp drawn through the site-conduit.
.MEASURE TRAN EFFECTIVE_CURRENT_MAGNIFICATION PARAM={GPI_MOTOR_RMS_CURRENT_A / (UPSTREAM_RMS_CURRENT_A + 1e-12)}

* ==============================================================================
* === 4. THE VAR VIRTUALIZATION & RESILIENCE BASE ===
* [DOMAIN TAG: ELECTRO-KINETIC RESILIENCE & TVRT]
* Why it is here: Uses Pythagorean logic to prove the massive, unyielding mechanical HP envelope and strictly label the VARs.
* ==============================================================================

* What it is: Formatting spacer.
.MEASURE TRAN ____4_VAR_VIRTUALIZATION_AND_ELECTRO_KINETIC_RESILIENCE____ PARAM={0}

* What it is: Upstream Active Sub-vector (The Horizontal Base).
* What it means: Quantifies the purely active kinetic extraction and thermal waste.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_UPSTREAM_ACTIVE_W PARAM={ABS(UPSTREAM_REAL_POWER_P_W)}

* What it is: Localized VAR Virtualization (The Vertical Height).
* What it does: Multiplies Capacitor RMS Current by Local RMS Voltage.
* What it means: The undeniable proof of VAR Virtualization. Quantifies the immense Reactive Power trapped internally, isolating the Site-Conduit from transit heat.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_VIRTUALIZED_VAR PARAM={GPI_CAP_RMS_CURRENT_A * GPI_LOCAL_RMS_VOLTAGE_V}

* What it is: True Vector Sum of the Applied Force Envelope.
* What it means: Provides an auditor-proof dimensional metric (VA) of the true composite resilient force hitting the rotor.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_ELECTRO_KINETIC_VA PARAM={GPI_LOCAL_APPARENT_POWER_S_VA}

* What it is: Effective NEMA / IEC Motor Frame Equivalent.
* What it means: Mathematically proves the manifold natively provides Transient Voltage Ride-Through (TVRT). The internal magnetic stiffness equals a massive 0.87 HP machine, averting load starvation during brownouts.
.MEASURE TRAN GPI_MANIFOLD_RESILIENT_HP_FRAME PARAM={GPI_MANIFOLD_ELECTRO_KINETIC_VA / 746}

.end
